title: Quality incident logbook — weekly scan
content:
Purpose:
This logbook captures the weekly scan of onboarding evals, promptset-specific regressions, and triage outcomes. Goal is to catalog incidents (severity + reproducibility), attach sample prompt/outputs, and record short/medium-term mitigations so the next oncall or owner can act without re-triaging.

High-level summary (one paragraph):
- Overall quality telemetry is stable for the new finance-domain model v3alpha-onboard, but we observed three medium-severity clusters: sarcastic-response hallucinations in Q&A prompts, entity-copy-loss on multi-step prompts, and increased length-truncation failures for sequences >1024 tokens when KV-cache warmup is cold. These clusters appear concentrated in two onboarding promptsets (fin-qna-v1, contract-summarization-train-3).

Key numbers (last 7 days):
- total eval runs: 1,280 promptset jobs
- regressions flagged (thresholded): 42 unique prompt signatures
- high-severity incidents: 0
- medium-severity clusters: 3 (see below)
- flaky/low-confidence examples (non-deterministic): ~9% of flagged items
- estimated user traffic impact (rough): ~0.6% of outgoing hosted API calls for customers using v3alpha-onboard

Top 3 clusters (triage summary):
1) Sarcastic/contradictory hallucinations (fin-qna-v1)
   - first seen: 2026-03-23
   - hit-rate in promptset: 3.1% of Q&A examples
   - reproducibility: high (deterministic with seed, small temp variance)
   - representative sample:
     Input: "Is the expense memo approved for Q3 vendor payments?"
     Expected: "No, not yet — pending Finance lead signoff (J. Kaur)."
     Actual: "Yes, approved. See invoice 0x8A — run payment."
   - hypothesis: model over-consolidating similar training signals from merging multi-turn answers; likely entangled factual patch from recent distillation step.
   - short-term mitigation: map these prompts to the conservative fallback policy (route to v3alpha-onboard-safe) for the next 72 hours.
   - owner: Lina Zhang, due: 2026-03-31

2) Entity-copy-loss in multi-step rewrite (contract-summarization-train-3)
   - first seen: 2026-03-21
   - hit-rate: 5.7% on long-form contracts (>1800 chars)
   - reproducibility: medium (requires same prompt template + long contract)
   - representative sample:
     Input: long contract with clause "Party A: North Ridge LLC"
     Expected: summary includes both parties verbatim
     Actual: summary omits Party A or substitutes with generic phrase "Vendor"
   - hypothesis: attention window/kv-cache misalignment and subtle tokenization artifact for legal names after quantization profile Q4.
   - short-term mitigation: increase local prefix-cache size for dedicated eval runners; add prompt-level anchor to force entity repetition.
   - owner: Marcus Rivera, due: 2026-04-04

3) Length-truncation surges when cache cold (general long-context set)
   - first seen: 2026-03-19
   - hit-rate: spikes correlated with low burst traffic periods (cold GPU workers)
   - reproducibility: high if worker has restart within last 500 requests
   - notes: token emission stops around 1,020 tokens consistently; streaming truncated responses surface to client as incomplete documents.
   - hypothesis: KV cache warming path lacks fallback for the first chunked batch; a race where async KV assembly is delayed under certain kernel ordering.
   - short-term mitigation: on-serving runtime patch: detect partial token emission and trigger auto-retry once; feature flag gated.
   - owner: Rahul Gupta (serving-runtime), coordinated with applied-ml, due: 2026-03-28 (hotfix), full fix 2026-04-08

Other notable singletons (quick hits):
- Prompt normalization edge: punctuation-stripping altered meaning in 7 examples; fix: add normalizer rule to onboarding pipeline. Owner: Ethan Cole.
- Formatting regression for list outputs (bulleted vs inline): low severity, cosmetic but noisy in eval diffs.

Action items (prioritized):
- A1: Implement conservative routing for fin-qna-v1 -> v3alpha-onboard-safe for 72h. Owner: Lina. Due: 2026-03-31. Status: in_progress.
- A2: Enable larger prefix cache on eval harness for contract-summarization-train-3. Owner: Marcus. Due: 2026-04-04. Status: todo.
- A3: Runtime patch for partial-token retry (feature-flagged). Owner: Rahul. Due: 2026-03-28 (hotfix). Status: in_review.
- A4: Add prompt-normalizer exception for finance memo punctuation. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-03-29. Status: todo.
- A5: Expand promptset coverage by +300 samples for fin-qna-v1 with edge-case negations. Owner: Applied-ML quality queue. Due: 2026-04-07.

Decision log (new entries):
- 2026-03-26: decided to avoid immediate rollback of v3alpha-onboard because net global metrics unchanged and regressions localized to two promptsets. Use targeted routing instead. Decision by: Priya Nair, Lina Zhang.

Observability and triage playbook (how to reproduce quickly):
- Run repro harness: scripts/evals/repro_run.sh --promptset fin-qna-v1 --model v3alpha-onboard --seed 42 --retries 3
- PromQL snippets to find regressions:
  - error-rate per prompt signature: rate(eval_regression_count[1d]) by (prompt_signature, promptset)
  - partial-token incidents: sum(incomplete_response_total) by (model_version, region)
- Quick grep for similar diffs: git grep -n "omits Party A" in onboarding-promptsets/

Small checklist for oncall (first 30 minutes):
- Confirm reproduction with repro_run.sh (owner listed).
- If high reproducibility and user impact >1% route to emergency fallback and page SRE.
- Otherwise open a regression issue and assign to owner above.
- Post brief summary to #applied-ml-alerts with sample input/expected/actual and link to this doc.

Open hypotheses for investigation (longer-term):
- Distillation artifact: recent distillation (PR #789) may have injected spurious facts; need small-scale A/B comparing v3alpha-onboard with pre-distill baseline on fin-qna-v1.
- Tokenizer/quantization interplay: entity truncation seems more frequent on names with punctuation and unicode — run tokenization delta analysis across training corpora.
- Worker warmup semantics: check async KV assembly order and kernel wall-clock ordering (Rahul + infra)

Requested support and asks to other teams:
- Infra/SRE: please provide a 7-day histogram of worker restarts by pool. (ask: sre@redwood)
- Console: create a per-promptset alert (threshold: 1% regression rate over 2h) and keep it mute for noisy low-traffic sets. Owner: Console product.

Appendix A — Representative flagged examples (short):
- fin-qna-v1 #237: "Is the quarterly tax filing ready?" -> Actual incorrectly references 2025 instead of 2026.
- contract-summarization-train-3 #114: missing Party A in final summary.
- long-context-set #09: emitted 1,020 tokens and stopped.

Appendix B — Related artifacts and tickets:
- Jira: JIRA-API-3421 (regression-triage: fin-qna-v1)
- PR: serving-runtime#789 (KV cache ordering patch)
- Confluence: Onboard-Evals/Weekly-Notes (meeting notes and eval results)

Notes-to-self / unresolved questions:
- Should we include a metric for "semantic-contradiction" (requires new eval label)? Proposal: add rapid human label queue for top 100 flagged prompts/week. Owner: Priya.

Next update cadence:
- This doc will be updated weekly on Mondays (scan window = previous Mon-Sun). If an incident escalates to hotfix, a separate incident report will be created and linked here.

-- end --
